title: Raise predicate-lock promotion thresholds to test SERIALIZABLE lock-wait regime
configuration_cause: max_pred_locks_per_page=2 and max_pred_locks_per_relation=-2 force early predicate-lock promotion to page/relation granularity, so SERIALIZABLE readers of GetUserTweets can serialize on coarse relation-level SIRead locks even though instantaneous lock_waiting_backends p95 is 0.
mechanism: Under SERIALIZABLE, GetUserTweets dominates terminal capacity (0.885) and its p99 (1121us) is 5.7x its p50 (196us). With max_pred_locks_per_page=2 and max_pred_locks_per_relation=-2, per-tuple SIRead locks promote to page then relation level almost immediately, so concurrent readers of the same tweet rows acquire conflicting coarse predicate locks and serialize. Raising per-page to 16 and per-relation to 64 keeps locks at tuple/page granularity longer, reducing false conflicts and tail latency without changing WAL or commit semantics. max_pred_locks_per_transaction stays at 8192 (already ample), so no lock-table exhaustion risk.
query_effect: GetUserTweets SIRead locks stay at tuple/page granularity longer, reducing coarse relation-level predicate-lock conflicts among concurrent SERIALIZABLE readers.
expected_tps_effect: Small increase in successful_transaction_tps as GetUserTweets tail latency drops; magnitude bounded because lock_waiting_backends is already 0 at p95.
expected_latency_effect: GetUserTweets p99 decreases; p50 roughly unchanged.

predictions.rationale: Coarser promotion removed; fewer relation-level SIRead conflicts shorten the tail.
Lower GetUserTweets tail frees terminal capacity, raising completed TPS.
Already 0; promotion thresholds should not create new waits.

alternatives.statement: If the tail is WAL-sync driven rather than predicate-lock driven, GetUserTweets p99 will not improve and wal_sync_time_per_txn stays flat; then the WAL commit-path bundle is the correct lever.
If the tail is buffer-miss driven, blks_read_per_txn stays high and shared_buffers/effective_cache_size is the correct lever.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Incumbent leaves predicate-lock promotion at aggressive defaults (page=2, relation=-2) despite a SERIALIZABLE workload whose dominant transaction shows a 5.7x p50-to-p99 tail; widening promotion thresholds is a low-risk, reload-only test of the lock-granularity mechanism.

nodes.label: Fewer coarse SIRead promotions, less serialization

knob_changes.numerical_basis: 8x current, within [0,256]; keeps tuple/page granularity longer before relation promotion.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: per-page SIRead lock budget before promotion

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Positive 64 replaces the -2 (half-of-transaction) heuristic, within [-2,4096]; delays relation-level promotion.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: per-relation SIRead lock budget before promotion

cross_domain_requirements: memory_storage owns shared_buffers/effective_cache_size coverage for low_buffer_hit_ratio
